_doc: Route -> frozen-prototype STRUCTURAL contract, read by check-prototype-fidelity.mjs. Author ONE entry per admin screen the prototype froze, when the prototype is frozen (PB-G3) — before the screen is built. The gate is STRICT for every route listed here and fail-soft for routes not listed. This is a SAMPLE/skeleton: it ships with routes:[] so a fresh project skips the gate until real screens are mapped. Replace the commented example with your real screens.
_howto: route              — the admin route path (e.g. /admin/courses). page.tsx is derived at apps/web/src/app<route>/page.tsx; override with `page` if it lives elsewhere.
prototypeFile      — the frozen export screen file this route adopts (for the failure message + the verifier glance). Optional but recommended.

requiredComponents — shared components the prototype implies. Each MUST be imported from a shared root (@/components, components/ui, …) AND used as <Comp/>. A locally re-drawn copy FAILS. Grid screens MUST list DataGrid.

requiredSections   — prototype sections. Built-in heuristics: kpi-row/stat-row -> <StatCard>, object-page-tabs/tabs -> <PageHead tabs=…> or <Tabs>, timeline -> <Timeline>, grid/table -> <DataGrid>, filter-bar/toolbar -> <FilterBar>/<Toolbar>, detail-panel -> <DetailPanel>/<SidePanel>, empty-state -> <EmptyState>. An unknown key falls back to a literal token-in-source check.
forbidRawTable     — default true: a raw <table> on the screen FAILS (grids render through DataGrid). Set false only for a genuine non-grid table.
sectionHeuristics  — optional per-route (or top-level) override: { "my-section": ["<MyThing"] } compiles the strings to regexes.
sharedImportRoots  — optional top-level override of the import roots that count as 'shared' (default @/components, components/ui, components/, ~/components, @components).
